comment: Catalogue of K815 LED effects. The effect number lives in phase B, byte 0x1a, low nibble.
source: extracted/app/1/skins/1_INI_EN/KbIndexText.ini (UTF-16 LE): the LED effect table starts at index 30, effect number = index - 30
verified: swept through the application: HR_LED_MODE=0/1/2/3/4/5/7/8/9/10/11 matched both the name shown in the UI and byte 0x1a

out_of_range.comment: Values outside 0..12 are undefined: with HR_LED_MODE=16 the application showed 'Comet Tail' while 0x00 went into the stream. The skin has one more entry, 'Cycle Color' (循环颜色) at index 46, but it does not fit the 4-bit field of 0x1a.
